newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber falls on Palembang deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber falls on Palembang deal.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in slow late trading on Friday following Singapore buying in Palembang and Jambi, dealers said.

Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices edged down 0.25 cents to 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"We have just sold February/March SIR20 at 54.63 fob Palembang, 54.13 fob Jambi and 54.50 fob Singapore," one Jakarta dealer said.
Dealers said a stream of fresh buying interest in late trading was mostly due to short-covering ahead of year-end.
One RSS1 dealer said RSS1 prices remained soft while sellers prefered to stay sidelined due to a lack of fresh buying interest.
